name: Escape HOLE for Brainrots!
desc:
Welcome to Escape HOLE for Brainrots! 🧠🕳️

🏃 Run fast and grab Brainrots!
🕳️ Outrun the roaming holes before they swallow you!
⚡ Rebirth to upgrade your running speed!
💸 Upgrade your Brainrots to earn more cash
🏗️ Upgrade your base to unlock more slots to place extra Brainrots
🎁 Gift Brainrots to your "connections" and grow together

Your Brainrots earn money while you are OFFLINE! 💤

Like the game and join the group for MORE UPDATES! 👍
